schema_source.admission: Coordinator explicitly accepted SP01-SP13 in current message; original CSV status PROPOSED is preserved in the exact source bytes

SP09.required_fields: owner_asset_or_flight_or_journey_or_base; category; scope; driver_unit; quantity; rate; amount; currency; price_year; fx_policy; accrual_month; noncash_flag; avoidability; shared_event_id; source_id; assumption_id
SP09.invariant: Учитывать net journey revenue, variable operating expense, incremental operating fixed/base/aircraft-use/startup/exit expenses и support по одному выбранному правилу. Δoperating_result = operating_P − operating_KEEP. CAPEX, financing и taxes отдельны; стоимость использования капитала не исчезает. Нельзя одновременно полную аренду и те же lease depreciation/interest без выбранной конвенции.

SP10.required_fields: economic_event_id nullable; related_asset_or_contract_id; payment_date_or_month; amount_signed; category operating/investing/tax/financing; currency; fx_at_payment; receivable_or_payable_change; deposit_flag; source_id; status; assumption_id
SP10.invariant: Один экономический event может иметь несколько платежей, а CAPEX/депозит не иметь текущего операционного расхода. Сверить открывающиеся/закрывающиеся receivables, advances, payables. Support отдельно начислен/получен, financing не revenue. Перед запуском включить реальные предоплаты; после 2028 сохранить обязательства/дебиторку/условия выхода.

SP11.required_fields: journeys; passenger_segments; compatible_carried_passengers; revenue_net; variable_contribution; operating_result; delta_operating_result; investing_cash; tax_cash; cash_before_financing; funding_before_financing; financing_cash; closing_cash; minimum_cash; metric_definition_id; denominator_id; unknown_dependencies
SP11.invariant: cash_before_financing = operating cash + investing cash + tax cash; delta и абсолютный поток не смешивать. Funding = max_t(0, minimum_cash_t − opening_cash − cumulative_cash_before_financing_t). Отдельно project incremental funding и whole-business funding, если KEEP cash известен. При неизвестном KEEP cash полный бюджет компании UNKNOWN.

economic_events.construction: Admitted rate * accepted quantity by owner, month and currency; net journey revenue once; shared_event_id deduplicates only inside the same evaluation
economic_events.negative_delta: Compute complete P and complete KEEP, then subtract; donor/opportunity memo is not a second expense
economic_events.noncash: Owned/capitalised asset depreciation: true. PBH reserve cash status depends on contract; hourly MRO reserves are not automatically noncash.
economic_events.unknown: No event amount until rate, quantity and scope are known or explicitly defined in a scenario/threshold branch. Published price stays a dated reference until future applicability is admitted.

cash_events.economic_event_id: nullable;CAPEX/advance/deposit can have no current operatingexpense
cash_events.owner: related_asset_or_contract_id links advances, final payment, deposit, refund and terminal balance
cash_events.one_to_many: One event may settle in several payments; copying accrual_month does not establish payment date

categories.operating: Customer/charter receipts; suppliers/rent/crew/MRO; support receipts/rebates; interest cash in finance_interest subcategory
categories.investing: Owned aircraft/base CAPEX and capital advances; refundable deposit asset flow flagged separately; asset disposal
categories.tax: VAT/profit-tax/excise payments and refunds under explicit posting policy; fuel support counted once
categories.financing: Debt principal/equity and financing-only fees; excluded from journey revenue; interest not deducted again

cash_events.tax_support_guard: Fuel credit is either operating support receipt or tax settlement flow under one posting policy. Tax offset has no bank receipt.
cash_events.balances: Reconcile opening/closing receivables, payables, inventory, advances, customer advances, deposits, debt and obligations beyond the horizon

boundaries.payload_special_case: max(-min(cumulative_cash)) requires opening_cash=0 and minimum_cash=0; valid as an explicit diagnostic/fixture, not observed RW liquidity
boundaries.unknown_opening_or_floor: Actual funding remains UNKNOWN; publish conditional incremental cash and boundary thresholds
boundaries.project_incremental: P minus KEEP cash by event on the same boundary; positive KEEP cash is available only if included with evidence of liquidity
boundaries.whole_business: Full RW funding is UNKNOWN if unaffected/KEEP cash is unknown; project budget does not establish company budget
boundaries.time: Include pre-launch and obligations beyond 2028; preserve event minima and monthly reports; end-2028 receivables/deposits are not automatically collected
boundaries.minimum_cash: Dated liquidity floor, separate from the minimum realised closing cash metric; no arbitrary reserve percentage

existing_inputs_unmodified: All 134 payload files and output_manifest remain byte-identical; supplement has a separate manifest
